required_work: Vendor github.com/yc-software/qm (MIT) as the dormant ioi.ai reference-UX seed under apps/ioi-ai/ as PINNED VERBATIM BYTES at a declared pin, minus a declared strip list, plus one provenance file. Retain the MIT license and attribution. DO NOT REBRAND: there is no display-only branding in this tree -- every YC string is an npm package identity (@yc-software/qm, including inside .md files where it sits in copy-pasteable install commands) or a git-origin check. Rewriting them forges machine identities, which this cut did once and had to undo. Branding belongs to the SERVED SURFACE and is owned by m5-qm-reference-shell-executable-rebind. Stack stays VERBATIM.
objective: Vendor the QM reference shell as PINNED VERBATIM BYTES, dormant: byte-identical to upstream at the declared pin modulo a declared exclusion list, not served, not rebound, not built, not resolved by the package manager.
falsifiable_claim: The claim fails if any adopted file differs from upstream bytes at the pin without a declared per-file deviation, if any upstream file is neither adopted nor declared excluded, or if any resolver, build, or serve path reaches the tree.
selected_profile: One dormant adopted tree under apps/ioi-ai/ with license provenance retained; zero serving, zero rebinding.
in_scope: Pinned verbatim vendoring: bytes-only fetch at the pin, declared strip list, MIT license and attribution retention, one added provenance file, and a completeness bar that proves the result in both directions.
A provenance note binding the upstream commit adopted.
Dormancy proof: no route serves the tree; no daemon or Agentgres binding references it.
out_of_scope: Serving, rebinding, executable or parity claims — owned by m5-qm-reference-shell-executable-rebind.
Any React port or stack substitution (the stack lands verbatim; surface-convergence stack choice is deferred).
Any change to the protected Hypervisor ported seed or to m4.md.
implementation_actions: Import the upstream tree at a pinned commit into apps/ioi-ai/ with license and attribution files retained.
Record the upstream pin, the strip list, and every deviation in the provenance note. No identity rewriting of any kind: a deviation list is MEASURED against the pin, never seeded from memory.
Prove dormancy: route census unchanged, no serve path, no binding.
positive_proof: The adopted tree exists under apps/ioi-ai/ at a pinned upstream commit, byte-identical to that pin modulo the declared strip list, with the MIT license and attribution retained and upstream identities INTACT, and no served route or binding references it.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Reject a served route to the dormant tree, a daemon/Agentgres binding from it, a missing license or attribution file, a REWRITTEN upstream identity (package name, tarball URL, or git-origin check), and any stack substitution.

Reject an adopted file that differs from upstream bytes without a declared per-file deviation: the completeness bar compares blob SHAs in both directions, so a forged identity cannot pass as a rebrand.

Reject an upstream file that is neither adopted nor on the declared exclusion list -- which is how three .gitignore files were silently skipped by `git add -A` honouring a .gitignore inside the tree being added.
Reject a stale deviation entry that is byte-identical to upstream: a deviation list nobody measures widens what may differ.

Reject a tree that the package manager still resolves while declared dormant. Reachability is asked of the RESOLVER, and not via `npm query`, which answers from the lock -- a cached resolution reported the tree unreachable while the config globbed it.
compatibility_and_migration: The dormant tree is additive; removing it restores the prior estate byte-exact.
